records.title: Fearless Concurrency on the GPU
records.reason: cuTile Rust extends Rust ownership to tile-based GPU kernel authoring with data-race freedom guarantees; a general GPU programming system, not an LLM inference kernel or serving contribution.

records.title: FastAFD: When Does Attention-FFN Disaggregation Pay on Rack-Scale NVLink?
records.reason: FastAFD builds an attention-FFN disaggregated MoE serving engine for GB200 NVL72 that overlaps MoE and attention microbatches and beats tuned vLLM wide expert parallelism on decode throughput; direct serving-system contribution.

records.title: Cicada: A Pipeline-Efficient Approach to Serverless Inference with Decoupled Management
records.reason: Cicada attacks serverless inference cold starts with pipelined model loading (MiniLoader, decoupled weight loading) coordinating compute, storage and scheduling; direct inference serving infrastructure.

records.title: AgentMath: Empowering Mathematical Reasoning for Large Language Models via Tool-Augmented Agent
records.reason: AgentMath builds tool-augmented SFT data and agentic RL so LLMs solve complex mathematics with code interpreters; a reasoning-capability framework with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Representational Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Committees: Measurement and Diversity-Aware Consensus
records.reason: Measures representational collapse in multi-agent LLM committees and adds a diversity-weighted consensus protocol with lower token cost; primarily a capability/measurement study of agent voting, not an inference system.

records.title: Do All Individual Layers Help? an Empirical Study of Task-Interfering Layers in Vision-Language Models
records.reason: Empirical study of task-interfering layers in vision-language models via per-layer interventions; an analysis of model behavior with no compression, serving, or inference-efficiency method proposed.

records.title: RouteProfile: Graph-Based Profiling for Cold-Start LLM Routing
records.reason: RouteProfile builds graph-based profiles of newly released LLMs from public signals so routers can cold-start model selection; it supports LLM routing but contributes profiling, not a serving or cost-optimization mechanism.

records.title: REEF: Representation Encoding Fingerprints for Large Language Models
records.reason: REEF fingerprints whether a suspect LLM derives from a victim model using representation similarity for IP protection; model-provenance detection with no inference efficiency or systems content.

records.title: 2-D SSM: A General Spatial Layer for Visual Transformers
records.reason: Proposes a 2-D state-space layer with efficient parameterization and accelerated computation inserted into Vision Transformers; an efficient vision architecture component, not an LLM inference system contribution.

records.title: Efficient Streaming LLM for Speech Recognition
records.reason: SpeechLLM-XL uses chunked limited-window attention for linear-scaling streaming speech recognition; the efficiency technique is real but the target is a speech-recognition application model, not LLM serving.

records.title: Multimodal Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction with Large Language Models
records.reason: Title itself states the work predicts multimodal clinical trial outcomes with LLMs, a medical outcome-prediction application; no inference-system technique is indicated in the title.

records.title: More Than Just Functional: LLM-as-a-Critique for Efficient Code Generation
records.reason: Uses a prompted LLM as an efficiency critique over the AST of generated code so code LLMs emit faster-running programs; the efficiency concerned is the generated code's runtime, not the LLM's inference system.

records.title: NEST: Nested Event Stream Transformer for Sequences of Multisets
records.reason: NEST is a nested event-stream Transformer architecture for sequences of multisets such as EHR encounters; a domain sequence-modeling architecture with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL
records.reason: Predictive Divergence Masks change token masking criteria in PPO-style reinforcement learning for LLMs; a training-algorithm contribution with no inference application.

records.title: Bayesian Entropy-based Reordering for Calibrated Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: BayesER is a post-hoc Bayesian decoding framework that orders token commitment in masked diffusion language models by predictive entropy; decoding-time, but aimed at calibration of generation rather than inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Mixtures of Experts for Scaling up Neural Networks in Order Execution
records.reason: Applies mixture-of-experts RL agents with spectral-clustering specialization to optimal order execution on NASDAQ Amazon stock data; a financial trading application, confirmed by the abstract.

records.title: Cookbook: A framework for improving LLM generative abilities via programmatic data generating templates
records.reason: Cookbook programmatically generates synthetic instruction data to fine-tune LLM generative abilities; a training-data construction framework with no inference-system content.

records.title: Joint Partitioning and Placement of Foundation Models for Real-Time Edge AI
records.reason: Formalizes joint layer partitioning and placement of foundation models across heterogeneous edge infrastructure as runtime-resolved optimization under latency and utilization constraints; direct distributed inference orchestration.

records.title: Bridging Brains and Models: MoE-Based Functional Lesions for Simulating and Rehabilitating Aphasia
records.reason: Lesions components of an MoE language model to simulate aphasia subtypes and validates outputs against patient speech; a neuroscience/cognitive-modeling study, not an inference contribution.

records.title: SCFormer: Structured Channel-wise Transformer with Cumulative Historical State for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: SCFormer adds temporal constraints and HiPPO historical state to a channel-wise Transformer for multivariate time-series forecasting; a forecasting architecture for a non-LLM application.
